name: Kelli M. Evans
title: Associate Justice, Supreme Court of California
years_of_service: Associate Justice since January 2, 2023 (nominated by Gov. Gavin Newsom August 10, 2022; confirmed unanimously November 10, 2022). (Wikipedia)
background: Evans earned a B.A. from Stanford (1991) and a J.D. from UC Davis School of Law (1994). (Wikipedia)

She began as an assistant public defender in Sacramento County (1995), then worked for the ACLU of Northern California (1995 to 1998), as a senior trial attorney in the U.S. Justice Department's Civil Rights Division (1998 to 2001), and in private civil-rights practice. She later served as a federal court monitor over the Oakland Police Department's consent decree and on the Cleveland police monitoring team, as associate director of the ACLU of Northern California (2010 to 2013), as senior director for the administration of justice at the State Bar (2014 to 2017), as a special assistant to the Attorney General (2017 to 2019), and as Gov. Newsom's chief deputy legal affairs secretary. (Wikipedia; CalMatters)

She was an Alameda County Superior Court judge from 2021 to 2023. Newsom nominated her to the Supreme Court seat vacated by Patricia Guerrero, and she is the court's first openly lesbian justice. November 3, 2026 is her first retention vote. (Wikipedia)
